summary: Verified localization fix for /app/public/map.html (Ukrainian -> English). File contains ZERO Cyrillic characters (U+0400-U+04FF) and every user-facing string is now in English. Confirmed both by regex-based Python scan of the file and by grep. As expected per the request, the public preview host serves the Emergent SPA placeholder at /map.html rather than the raw asset, so the primary acceptance was verified via direct file inspection.

issues: Line 2: <html lang="uk"> still declares Ukrainian as the document language. Not visible to users but affects screen readers and triggers browser 'Translate this page?' prompts. Should be lang="en".

Lines 164 & 182: Nominatim geocoder calls still pass accept-language=uk. This causes the reverse-geocoded address text (shown in #address) and search result names (shown in #search-results) to be returned in Ukrainian for places that have Ukrainian names. For a US/English-only app both should be accept-language=en.

geolocation_errors_english: Could not determine your location. Check your browser permissions.
verification_checklist.radius_chip_unit_logic: chip.textContent = r + ' ' + UNIT; UNIT = params.get('unit') === 'mi' ? 'mi' : 'km' -- correct: admin (unit=mi) -> 'mi', provider (default) -> 'km'

action_items: Change accept-language=uk to accept-language=en on the two Nominatim fetch URLs in /app/public/map.html (lines 164 and 182) so reverse-geocoded addresses and city search results are returned in English.
critical_code_review_comments: Localization fix is complete for all hard-coded user-facing strings in map.html. Remaining locale references are not visible text but still bias the UI toward Ukrainian at runtime (document lang + geocoder language).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the requested string-localization scope; 2 residual non-string locale settings noted

test_credentials: Not used - static asset verification only. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview pod serves the Expo/Emergent SPA placeholder at any non-API route (including /map.html), so live iframe rendering of the map cannot be exercised via Playwright in this environment. Verify localization by scanning /app/public/map.html for Cyrillic (U+0400-U+04FF) with Python re.findall. Additionally check <html lang> and Nominatim accept-language query params on lines 164/182 to catch non-string locale leaks.
rca of the issue: Original file was authored in Ukrainian (lang="uk", Cyrillic labels for placeholder, buttons, headings, toasts, error messages, chip units). The fix translated all user-facing strings to English. Residual Ukrainian locale references remain in the <html lang> attribute and in the accept-language=uk query param on two Nominatim API calls; these do not print Ukrainian literals from the HTML but do cause runtime Ukrainian text to appear in geocoded address/search results.
